intro: What’s new in each IsleMap release. Newest first.

entries.title: All players map for everyone
highlights: Required update — All players is available in installed builds with live pins from every online IsleMap client
Filter pins by Primal Pinas !map or Asset Location; click Primal pins for dino portrait, class, and growth
Every client shares location on the live map (not presence-only)
Group Advanced no longer exposes internal sync settings

entries.title: Setup, Primal Pinas live location & asset panel
highlights: Major release — required Setup flow unlocks Show map only after you choose a location strategy
Primal Pinas !map live tracking with facing yaw, velocity smoothing, and dual-mode Asset Location
Live asset panel matches your dinosaur class to Primal Pinas caps portraits and growth
NVIDIA-style Setup UI, setup-required modal, Audio beat spectrum (av-circle), and Gateway Realistic map option

entries.title: Audio beat, recording & screenshots
highlights: Audio beat is the default rim effect — reacts to desktop/game sound with tunable sensitivity, punch, and rings
Screen recording with desktop audio, background encode, and an HD clip library
Screenshots module for map or full-monitor captures with hotkeys and clipboard options
Updated default hotkeys (− / = / F10 / F1 / F2) plus guided tutorial coverage for the new settings

entries.title: 3D pin, FOV, and border effects
highlights: 3D dinosaur player pin with size, glow, orientation, and head-follows-facing
Richer FOV styles (line of sight, beam, soft) with angle and length controls
Animated border effects including 3D dragon / dinosaur rim runners
Map editor and All players stay developer-only (not shown in installs)

entries.title: Testers, groups & online count
highlights: Contributors page lists Testers (Shin, ShenYI)
Group host/joiner fixes and clearer peer last-seen pins
Online user count in the dashboard header
Prompt for game username on first run when needed

entries.title: Official map, borders & sanctuaries
highlights: Choose Gateway or Gateway Official (official art is the default)
New Primal Pinas Border frame design
Welcome screen explains IsleMap is EAC-safe and won’t get you banned
Sanctuary place category with filter, rim stick, and hotkeys

entries.title: In-app changelog
highlights: Updates page now lists what’s new in each release
Required-update screen shows highlights for the version you’re installing

entries.title: Force-update polish
highlights: Installed version shows correctly in the required-update screen (no more v?)
Download finished no longer auto-opens the installer — click Restart & install when ready

entries.title: Group works in packaged builds
highlights: Built-in group sync credentials so Group no longer needs a local .env auth server

entries.title: Group sync & durable data
highlights: Create or join a squad lobby and see peer pins on the overlay (username + PC ID)
Settings, identity, and custom places persist across updates
Map editor stays hidden in production builds

entries.title: Calibration & contributors
highlights: Improved Gateway coordinate mapping and wallow / focus controls
Contributors page added
Map place editor limited to developer builds

entries.title: Updater accuracy
highlights: Prefer GitHub Releases API so stale latest.yml no longer blocks updates

entries.title: Focus-aware overlay
highlights: Overlay shows only while The Isle (or map mode) is focused
Show map stays enabled across Alt-Tab

entries.title: Required updates
highlights: Newer GitHub releases can lock the map until you install

entries.title: Download reliability
highlights: Fix stuck updater downloads on Windows

entries.title: Unsigned Windows updater
highlights: Auto-updater works for unsigned Windows builds

entries.title: Branding & docs
highlights: IsleMap branding, expanded README, and release channel polish

entries.title: Initial release
highlights: EAC-safe clipboard-based Gateway overlay map
GitHub Releases auto-updater
